items.title_orig: “Mike McCready, Kim Thayil and I have always been fans of Ace Frehley. Mike showed me some Ace riffs over the years that I still use”: No matter what Soundgarden’s future holds, Matt Cameron’s love of guitar continues
items.article_text:
Cameron looked up to local legends like Buzz Osborne, Jerry Cantrell and Tom Price. But above all else, his friendship with McCready – sometimes an auxiliary Soundgarden player – helped solidify his interest in guitar. Sometimes the Pearl Jam man borrows Cameron’s prized amp, a vintage Vox AC30; he’s used it on several Pearl Jam albums.
 “Chris Cornell always said Mike was our honorary fifth member,” Cameron says. McCready’s most recent appearance with Soundgarden was during halftime of the opening home game for reigning Super Bowl champs, the Seattle Seahawks. “It was a blast. Having Taylor Momsen, Mike, [Seahawks drumline] Blue Thunder and our crew join us made it all the more special.”
 Cameron, Thayil and bassist Ben Shepherd are nearing the release of their last recordings with Cornel
